description: Header file defining interface and constants for RT1718S GPIO driver in Zephyr OS, including register addresses, configuration structures, and inline functions for register access.

methods.name: rt1718s_reg_read_byte
methods.description: Reads a byte from a specified RT1718S register via I2C.

methods.name: rt1718s_reg_burst_read
methods.description: Reads multiple bytes starting from a specified register address.

methods.name: rt1718s_reg_write_byte
methods.description: Writes a byte to a specified RT1718S register via I2C.

methods.name: rt1718s_reg_burst_write
methods.description: Writes multiple bytes starting from a specified register address.

methods.name: rt1718s_reg_update
methods.description: Updates a register only if the new value differs from the current.

methods.name: rt1718s_gpio_alert_handler
methods.description: Handles GPIO port alert for RT1718S device.
